goal: Allow block benchmarks to reflect modern SegWit and Taproot transaction patterns
Avoid repository bloat by generating test blocks dynamically instead of committing static raw blocks
reviewability: Wait for author to rebase due to merge conflicts with the base branch
agreement: Broad support for replacing the obsolete 2016 block fixture with a dynamic generator
Strong support because benchmarking only against pre-SegWit blocks is inadequate (hodlinator)
Support because runtime generation saves repository space and adds extensibility (0xB10C)
Support for testing benchmarks against realistic modern transaction mixes (Raimo33, yuvicc)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it replaces obsolete 2016 block fixtures with modern SegWit and Taproot script mixes
It improves benchmark realism and unblocks configurable future block and undo I/O benchmarks
It avoids repository bloat from committing large static blocks over time
